final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS cnt FROM Accounts a JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.st AS st, s1.cnt AS cnt, (s1.cnt * 1.0) / s2.total AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS av FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.st AS st, s3.cnt AS cnt, s3.r AS r, s3.r - s4.av AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.av) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM s5
